original_ai_output.title_zh: 法院将FIJ记者Daniel Ojukwu还押至Kuje监狱，涉及其关于布哈里助手的报道
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 阿布贾联邦高等法院将调查新闻基金会（FIJ）记者Daniel Ojukwu还押至Kuje监狱，事由是他发表了关于前总统布哈里可持续发展目标高级特别助理Adejoke Orelope-Adefulire的调查报道。法官Joyce Abdulmalik于11月10日周二下令还押，此前Ojukwu对12项涉及据称网络跟踪和刑事诽谤的指控表示不认罪。法院将案件延期至2026年12月1日审理其保释申请，记者将继续被拘留。该案由警察总监提起，FIJ创始人Fisayo Soyombo被列为第二被告，检方称其在外逃匿并申请了拘捕令。

location.raw_text: A FEDERAL High Court in Abuja ... Kuje Correctional and Custodial Centre

key_facts.fact: 阿布贾联邦高等法院将FIJ记者Daniel Ojukwu还押至Kuje监狱
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A FEDERAL High Court in Abuja has remanded Daniel Ojukwu, a correspondent with the Foundation for Investigative Journalism (FIJ), in Kuje Prison

key_facts.fact: 还押事由是其关于布哈里前助手的调查报道
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: over investigative reports he published about Adejoke Orelope-Adefulire, a former Senior Special Assistant to the late President Muhammadu Buhari on Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)

key_facts.fact: 法官Joyce Abdulmalik于11月10日周二下令还押，此前Ojukwu对12项指控表示不认罪
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Joyce Abdulmalik, a justice of the court ordered Ojukwu’s remand at the Kuje Correctional and Custodial Centre on Tuesday, November 10, after he pleaded not guilty to a 12-count charge

key_facts.fact: 指控涉及据称网络跟踪和刑事诽谤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: a 12-count charge bordering on alleged cyberstalking and criminal defamation

key_facts.fact: 法院将案件延期至2026年12月1日审理保释申请
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The court adjourned the case until December 1, 2026, for the hearing of his bail application

key_facts.fact: 该案由警察总监提起，FIJ创始人Fisayo Soyombo被列为第二被告
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The case, filed by the Inspector-General of Police, also lists Fisayo Soyombo, FIJ’s founder, as the second defendant

key_facts.fact: 检方称Soyombo在外逃匿并申请拘捕令
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the prosecution applied for a bench warrant against Soyombo, claiming he was at large

uncertainties: 网络跟踪和刑事诽谤指控为据称性质，尚未经法院裁决
检方关于Soyombo在外逃匿的说法尚未获独立确认
目前仅单一来源（ICIR）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
